description:
List top Google Discover pages of a property ranked by a chosen metric, with period-over-period change against the equal-length window immediately before the range. Discover is the Google Discover feed surface, distinct from Search performance (use get_top_pages for Search pages). Accepts a date range as presets (last_7_days, last_28_days, last_3_months, last_year) or absolute dates (from/to in Y-m-d). Sort by clicks (default), impressions, or ctr. Each page returns clicks/impressions/ctr as *_current plus *_change_pct (ctr is a 0-1 fraction). Cursor-paginated: pass the returned next_cursor back as cursor to page. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 5 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Top 25 Discover pages by clicks over the last 28 days.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","range":"last_28_days","sortBy":"clicks","limit":25}
```

range.description: Date-range preset. Mutually exclusive with from/to; pass either range or both from and to.
